instructions: Write only the supplied authorized source knowledge in the requested language and the source's own voice. Keep neutral descriptions separate from authored evidence.
Distinguish document format, documentary family and investigative role. Fictional newspapers, magazines, notes, receipts, diaries, letters and digital exports need complete original content.
Civil materials must not acquire police seals, confidential bands, fabricated verification or omniscient culprit labels. Layouts control appearance, never add facts.
contract: Preserve supplied asset/source IDs, type, author identity, source time and assigned observations.
Support uses exact excerpts present in the material, not a title, description, image prompt or later private explanation.
Tables have complete rows, reconciled totals and canonical dates; image compilations contain actual validated embedded bytes, never invented filenames.
positiveExample: An original fictional magazine article discusses the business dispute known at publication time; a dated handwritten note uses the writer's limited knowledge.
negativeExample: A receipt has empty totals, a note explains that it is a red herring, or a renderer adds a laboratory result not supplied to the author.
criteria: No placeholders, essential missing fields or description-as-document fallback.
Readable text survives rendering; all four supported languages have localized chrome.
Source identity, facts, precision and timing match the canonical assignment.
